description: Renders frames of a composition in the user's tab and returns them as one labelled contact sheet; nothing is saved or changed. atFrames takes up to 12 frames; omitted, the sheet is an even spread plus the joins between scenes (labelled "end of a scene", "start of a scene", "mid transition"). One frame comes back at 1560 px, two at 960, for checking detail. `props` are merged over the composition's for this render only, e.g. {partsBoard:true}. Each frame reports its content share (how much is not background); one far below its neighbours is usually a gap between scenes.

props.description: Merged over the composition's props for this render only, e.g. {partsBoard:true}.

token.description: The session token that connect returned.

name: inspect_composition
title: Render frames
